hypothesis: Under high-frequency burst conditions (> 25 dispatches/sec), the immune bus rate-limiter and sliding-window monitor detect an agent storm, apply backpressure, suppress duplicate evaluations, and preserve core telemetry processing.
control: Standard operating baseline: 0.2 to 1.5 messages per second across 12 cells.
perturbation: Adversarial synthetic flood: 35 messages dispatched within a 200 ms interval into the ImmuneBus.

recovery_behavior.recovery_verification: When message rate falls below 25.0/sec over the sliding window, activeStormDetected resets to false without requiring process restart.
